packageRules.description: Pin devDependencies exactly; let runtime deps float within their range.
Automerge minor and patch bumps once CI is green.

Block only MAJOR react-router bumps. v8 consolidates react-router-dom into react-router, so an automated major would break every import; patch and minor updates must stay visible because that is how a future security fix arrives. See the accepted advisory in SECURITY.md.
